name: COD24 Shipping For Woocommerce
author: cod24

sections.description:
The COD24 WooCommerce Shipping Plugin is a product developed by the COD24 company. COD24 is a postal transport intermediary company that offers services such as postal, Tipax, urban courier, and more. This plugin implements the company’s services within the WooCommerce platform. Using this plugin, store managers can connect WooCommerce to the postal panel.
This plugin automatically transfers the total cart amount to the postal panel, calculates the shipping cost online, and then adds it to the total order amount. Managers can also transfer the entire order to the postal panel after placing the order.
It’s important to note that the postal panel connects to the store via a web service, and we have designed this web service to be secure. We attach great importance to user rights and data, and we recommend that you read the privacy policy of our plugin.

Key features of the plugin:

  • Ability to add Iran Post’s priority shipping in WooCommerce
  • Ability to activate Iran Post’s special shipping in WooCommerce
  • Ability to activate Tipax shipping
  • Ability to activate Chapar & Alopeyk (coming soon)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the wp-content/plugins/tida-quotes directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
sections.faq:
This plugin is free

Yes, the COD24 WooCommerce Shipping Plugin is a free plugin.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is compatible with WooCommerce and adds various shipping methods to the WooCommerce platform.

How does this plugin work?

You first need to purchase the COD24 postal panel. Then, you need to obtain the web service key and enter it in the plugin settings section of the WooCommerce configuration. Once this is done, the plugin will be connected to the postal panel.
